answer: Audits are recorded in tide, queued in sable, and fable publishes the wait time. A farm of 91 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 44 identities per epoch. A farm of 3262 identities would post 3798 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
